about: Editorial decisions made on top of the research. The research files record what the sources say, including where they disagree; a decision records which reading the atlas uses, why, and what it set aside. The builds apply these after reading the research, and never edit the research files themselves. See research/README.md, 'Recording a decision'.

decisions.subject: sub-agencies/bc-timber-sales

value.locator: "BC Timber Sales (BCTS) was established on June 20, 2003 with a mandate to support the market-based pricing system…"
value.meaning: as BC Timber Sales dates itself, in its 10th-anniversary release of 2013

decisions.reason: The organisation's own official founding date. It is not the first sign of the body: BCTS replaced the Small Business Forest Enterprise Program and was operating from April 2003, and its name is in the Gazette on 29 May 2003. Those stay as events. No order in council or regulation dated 20 June 2003 was found; the Gazette of 26 June 2003 shows the handover still under way.

set_aside.why: The Small Business program's replacement and BCTS becoming operational — an earlier milestone, not the date BCTS gives for its establishment.
An observation of the name in use, not an establishment.

decisions.subject: sub-agencies/workbc

value.meaning: the WorkBC strategy and website launch

decisions.reason: This record is WorkBC as a whole — the brand, website and services — not only its centres, so it starts when WorkBC itself was launched: the strategy and WorkBC.ca, unveiled 27 April 2007 and confirmed by a 2008 backgrounder. The centres' opening on 2 April 2012 stays as an operational event. Proposed in research round 2 (reviews/round-2/decision-recommendations.json).

set_aside.why: The WorkBC centres and Employment Program of BC began — an operational milestone of the services, not the start of WorkBC.

decisions.subject: sub-agencies/medical-services-commission

value.meaning: the day fixed for the Medical Services Act, 1967 (s. 3 constitutes the Commission) to come into force; the first members took office the same day (OIC 965/1967)

decisions.reason: The Commission is constituted by s. 3 of the Medical Services Act, 1967 (assented 23 March 1967). OIC 964/1967 directs a proclamation bringing every provision but s. 9 into force on 24 March 1967; OIC 965/1967 appoints its three members from that day, and OIC 967/1967 sets its staff from 25 March. A 1968 staffing order and a June 1968 public notice in the Commission's name show it in existence before July 1968. The proclamation itself was not retrieved.

set_aside.why: The Commission's 2002 and 2004 financial statements (note 1) say it was established 1 July 1968 'under the Medical Service Act'. That is the Medical Services Plan's Medicare start, written decades later; the 1967 instruments are contemporary. Kept as a retrospective claim (atlas:institutional-history-msc-1968). Whether a 1968 statute re-constituted the Commission was not checked.

decisions.subject: sub-agencies/environmental-appeal-board

value.meaning: The day OIC 2603/1981 establishes the Environmental Appeal Board under s. 11 of the Environment Management Act, SBC 1981 c. 14 ('effective January 1, 1982, there be established an Environmental Appeal Board'); the order was approved 18 December 1981, which is not the start
value.locator: OIC 2603/1981, approved and ordered 18 December 1981, sole operative paragraph; PDF p. 1

decisions.reason: OIC 2603/1981 establishes the Board 'effective January 1, 1982' under s. 11 of the Environment Management Act, SBC 1981 c. 14; OIC 2602/1981 brings ss. 11-12 into force that day and OIC 2604/1981 appoints the first members (chairman Francis A. Hillier) from it. All three were approved 18 December 1981. This settles the Round 2 proposal (reviews/round-2/decision-recommendations.json, proposed-environmental-appeal-board-established-1982) at day precision.

set_aside.why: The collected year and the Board's homepage: the year of the Environment Management Act, not of the Board. The orders were approved in December 1981 but take effect in 1982.
The Board's procedure manual (2019) at year precision; it agrees with the orders and is superseded by them.

decisions.subject: sub-agencies/powertech-labs

value.meaning: Incorporation of the company registered as BC0352143, under the numbered name 352143 B.C. LTD.; it took the name Powertech Labs Inc. on 6 January 1989. A legal start, not the start of the laboratory's work
value.locator: BC Registries credential 493544 (BC0352143): registration_date and entity_name_effective 1988-09-29, reason Event:CONVICORP (converted legacy record)

decisions.reason: The record is the company Powertech Labs Inc. (BC0352143), BC Hydro's subsidiary, so it starts when that company was incorporated: 29 September 1988, as 352143 B.C. Ltd., named Powertech Labs Inc. from 6 January 1989 (OrgBook BC credentials 493544 and 493593). The laboratory's own history is older and stays as events.

set_aside.why: BC Hydro's 2009 news release dates Powertech's service delivery from 1989: the laboratory's operations, probably the year it took its name; not the incorporation.
BC Hydro's 2020 service plan says Powertech has operated 'since its inception in 1979': a retrospective statement about the laboratory function, before the company existed.
